title: Layer 3 round 3 major SE: the broken-state human form's file-path line interpolates raw — one line below the #784 fix; a hostile repo subdirectory name reaches the terminal

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in 94d3c2cf: broken.rs's shown_path now crosses clean_for_terminal — the file-path line no longer interpolates raw. A hostile repo checked out with a control-or-bidi subdirectory name (attacker-influenced cwd, the same threat mode as state.yaml content) can no longer put those bytes on the terminal through the broken-state diagnostic. Covered by the extended broken-state cleaning test.
